title: Deadline Report
description: A deadline report for an assignment, stored in reports/<assignment-id>.json.

assignment_id.description: ID of the assignment this report covers.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this report was generated.

generator_version.description: Version of the report generator that produced this report.

source_revision.description: Git commit SHA of the control repo at generation time.

live_refreshed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last frontend Live Status refresh. Populated by the Admin UI; overwritten on next backend export.

live_refreshed_by.description: GitHub login of the lecturer who triggered the last Live Status refresh.

archive_repo.description: owner/name of the archive repository holding this team's preserved branch. Per assignment (pxl-classroom-archive-<id>); null on rows preserved before per-assignment archives, which are in the org's pxl-classroom-archive.

archive_ref.description: The ref preserve.mjs pushed to, e.g. refs/heads/preserved/<id>/<team-slug>. Authoritative over reconstructing the branch name.

seeded_from.description: Provenance carried over from teams/<id>/<slug>.json when the team was seeded rather than student-formed.

team_slug.description: Team slug if the student is in a team for a group assignment.

team_name.description: Display name of the team if in a group assignment.

student_number.description: Institutional student number, if linked via roster.

email.description: Institutional student email, if linked via roster.

class_group.description: Student class group, if linked via roster.

author_name.description: Git commit author name from repository commits.

author_email.description: Git commit author email from repository commits.

acceptance_state.description: Acceptance status of the student for this assignment.

claimed_email.description: The address this acceptance was admitted on, under roster_mode claim or open. Null when no address was confirmed - which is normal under open, where the claim is optional.

claim_verified.description: Whether the student confirmed a GitHub-verified address rather than typing one. Evidence, never enforcement.

claim_domain_allowed.description: Whether the confirmed address was inside claim_domains. Null when there is no address to say it about. Under open this is detection: an address outside the list is recorded, never refused.

repo_id.description: GitHub repository ID, if a repo exists.

repo_name.description: Full repository name in org/repo format.

repo_url.description: HTML URL of the student's repository.

submission_status.description: Whether the submission was on time, late, missing, or indeterminate.

last_on_time_sha.description: SHA of the last commit observed before the deadline.

last_on_time_observed_at.description: Timestamp of the last on-time observation.

first_late_sha.description: SHA of the first commit observed after the deadline.

first_late_observed_at.description: Timestamp of the first late observation.

latest_observed_sha.description: SHA of the most recent observation regardless of timing.

latest_observed_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent observation.

commit_date.description: Actual author/committer timestamp of the latest commit.

latest_commit_date.description: Actual author/committer timestamp of the latest commit.

commit_message.description: Commit message of the latest observed commit.

latest_commit_message.description: Commit message of the latest observed commit.

commit_count.description: Total commit count on the submission ref. Populated by backend collection and frontend refresh.

late_commit_count.description: Commits on the submission ref after THIS student's effective deadline, counted by collect/ against GitHub's own `since` filter. null means not known - an assignment collected before this field existed, or a count the API would not answer - and is deliberately distinct from 0, which means none.

uncertainty_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between the last on-time and first late observation. Indicates confidence in the deadline boundary.

effective_deadline_at.description: The deadline that applies to THIS student, from lib/effective-deadline.mjs - the assignment's own deadline unless a lecturer granted an extension. Every comparison against 'the deadline' downstream is against this, not against the assignment's.

override_applied.description: True when an extension moved this student's deadline. An extension only ever EXTENDS: a value earlier than the assignment deadline is ignored rather than shortening it.

override_reason.description: The reason the lecturer recorded with the extension, or null when none applies.

lockdown_delay_seconds.description: Seconds between the deadline and the moment this student actually stopped being able to push, read from lockdowns/<id>/lockdown-record.json. NOT the same measure as uncertainty_interval_seconds, which is the other side of the deadline - how stale the evidence was going IN. Conflating them made the preservation banner show hours of 'lockdown delay' for a cohort the sentinel had frozen at the instant. Null before a lockdown record exists, and null when nothing was stopped (lock_method: none).

tagged_submission_tag.description: Full tag name of the latest observed submit/ tag.

tagged_submission_sha.description: SHA of the commit pointed to by the latest submit/ tag.

tagged_submission_observed_at.description: Timestamp when the submit/ tag was observed.

tagged_submission_declared_at.description: Declared student timestamp parsed from the submit/ tag name.

lock_down_at.description: Timestamp when the repository was locked down.

preservation_status.description: Status of the deadline snapshot preservation.

preserved_sha.description: SHA of the preserved deadline snapshot.

archive_repo.description: owner/name of the archive repository holding this student's preserved branch. Per assignment (pxl-classroom-archive-<id>); null on rows preserved before per-assignment archives, which are in the org's pxl-classroom-archive.

archive_ref.description: The ref preserve.mjs pushed to, e.g. refs/heads/preserved/<id>/<login>. Authoritative over reconstructing the branch name, which is wrong for group assignments (a team shares one repository and is preserved under its team slug).

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings about this student's submission.
